name: git push
purpose: Upload local commits from your branch to a remote GitHub repository.
syntax:
git push -u origin main
git push
explanation: 'git push -u origin main' uploads your local 'main' branch to the 'origin' remote and remembers the upstream link so future uploads only need 'git push'.

parameters.description: Sets upstream tracking between your local branch and the remote branch.

expectedOutput: Branch 'main' set up to track remote branch 'main' from 'origin'.
whenToUse: After committing locally when you want to share or back up code on GitHub.
commonMistakes: Pushing before committing changes (git push only uploads committed snapshots).
